meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 macOS 菜单栏加入一个闪电图标，显示绿点（运行中）或红点（已停止），并提供开始、停止、重启及查看日志等控制。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器，或直接输入 /add-macos-statusbar 时触发；仅适用于 macOS。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个菜单栏状态图标
say.note: Claude 会检查系统环境并开始安装。
直接触发本技能的执行流程。

say.text: 帮我在 macOS 菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态
say.note: 安装后可通过图标查看状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a persistent menu bar icon (a bolt) on macOS. A green dot shows NanoClaw is running; a red dot shows it's stopped. Users can start, stop, restart, or view logs from the menu.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw, or enters /add-macos-statusbar. macOS only.

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Claude checks the environment and installs it.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's running status in the macOS menu bar
